text: Go confidently in the direction of your dreams. Live the life you have imagined.
author: Henry David Thoreau

text: Sei geduldig gegen alles Ungelöste in deinem Herzen und versuche, die Fragen selbst liebzuhaben.
author: Rainer Maria Rilke

text: The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
author: Marcus Aurelius

text: Wer ein Warum zum Leben hat, erträgt fast jedes Wie.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

text: Wo aber Gefahr ist, wächst das Rettende auch.
author: Friedrich Hölderlin

text: While we are postponing, life speeds by.
author: Seneca

text: Es ist nicht genug, zu wissen, man muß auch anwenden; es ist nicht genug, zu wollen, man muß auch tun.
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

text: If a week in another country gives you more happiness than the whole time you spent in your hometown, then you have the answer you’ve been looking for.
author: Anonymous

text: Someday, all the places you’ve traveled will exist only in your memories. Make sure you have beautiful ones to look back on.
author: Anonymous

text: We are all broken, that’s how the light gets in.
author: Anonymous

text: What are you afraid of losing, when nothing in this world truly belongs to you?
author: Marcus Aurelius

text: Between what is said and not meant, and what is meant and not said, most of love is lost.
author: Kahlil Gibran

text: If you asked me how many times you came into my mind, I would say once. Because you came and never left.
author: Mahmoud Darwish

text: The cheat code to life is being ridiculously optimistic and slightly delusional about how far you can actually go.
author: Anonymous

text: You will continue to suffer if you have an emotional reaction to everything that is said to you. True power is sitting back and observing things with logic. True power is restraint. If words control you that means everyone else can control you. Breathe and allow things to pass.
author: Anonymous

text: We are more often frightened than hurt; and we suffer more from imagination than from reality.
author: Seneca

text: Men are disturbed not by the things which happen, but by the opinions about the things.
author: Epictetus

text: Such as are thy habitual thoughts, such also will be the character of thy mind; for the soul is dyed by the thoughts.
author: Marcus Aurelius

text: Let there be spaces in your togetherness, and let the winds of the heavens dance between you.
author: Kahlil Gibran

text: Life shrinks or expands in proportion to one’s courage.
author: Anaïs Nin
source: The Diary of Anaïs Nin, Vol. 3
